rational_review.coordinate_basis: Exact Fraction conversion of original binary64 values passed to GDAL; all primitive-edge squared distances minimized algebraically. Square roots only converted for comparison/reporting. No path samples, no optimizer, no replanning.

limitations: Containment is independently rerun with the same GDAL/GEOS kernel, not a separate formal full-containment proof.
Rational checks use represented binary64 geometry, not survey truth.
Hypothetical translating disk only; no machine dimensions, turning/heading/dynamics/implement/coverage conclusions.
Twelve instances are nested prefixes on one field, not twelve independent fields.
